prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in & account: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in post-waiting hurt, while account sync hints and safety notices showed no clear effect.
Path selection: Headline updates (clarity and value proposition), spotlight layouts, and visual story stage redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while hints and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.
Waiting room: Interactive waiting rooms, desktop visibility/readiness status checks, and spawn location hints won; progress trackers, timers, sound notifications, and compatibility screens showed no clear effect.
Adoption flow: Split photo upload previews with quality guides won; compact grids, guidelines banners, stamp redesigns, and fallback or multi-step inspection flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews, incentives, and layout customizations showed no clear effect.
Finish & placement: Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome redesigns, docking hints, and retrieval callouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions accuracy: Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive flow wins (such as placement verification screens and spawn placement flows) and overpredicted gains on severe flow failures (such as stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, multi-step inspection, and guided spawn stages).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Pick Friend Selection View: Redesign the companion selection screen into a spotlight view highlighting personality traits and custom vs starter choices. (why: Adoption has the highest funnel drop-off (68.9% conversion) with long median time (89s), indicating users struggle with companion selection.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Character Confirmation Stage: Insert a companion preview stage right after photo upload to confirm companion visual settings before certificate generation. (why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet generation output failing or looking unexpected.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Photo Sign-In Sequence: Move sign-in directly after companion picking and before photo upload so character choices are immediately attached to the account. (why: Support receives 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, making early account attachment critical.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Launch Preparation Flow: Add a dedicated desktop launch verification step during waiting to prepare screen real estate before mascot spawn. (why: 3 support tickets cited pets failing to show on desktop or the app stalling at startup after onboarding.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Reassurance Note: Display a hint on path selection explaining that starter vs custom paths can be switched anytime later. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s (vs 8s median), showing a long tail of hesitant users.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Quality Advice Tip: Add clear image requirements hint on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and pose guidance. (why: Users report custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong output.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Link Guarantee Copy: Update sign-in screen hint to explicitly state that pets and items are bound to the cloud account. (why: Account pet sync/reset is the largest single issue in support tickets (8 emails).)
7: [home, notification] Background Spawn Readiness Notification: Trigger a timely desktop notification when hatching completes while waiting in background. (why: Waiting stage median time is 201s with long mean times (2336s), leading to user dropoff or impatience.)
8: [finish, incentive] First Day Desktop Welcome Note: Add an inviting welcome headline and action button on the final screen prompting the user's first desktop click. (why: 82.3% finish conversion leaves room to improve onboarding completion and initial engagement.)
